game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Glyph Corridor, a corridor of glyphs: the relic hunter must handle cursed statues while practicing lists. Core idea – Comprehension Lab: Build new lists in one line with list comprehensions to transform chalk marks.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Glyph Corridor: a corridor of glyphs
core_gameplay_loop: In Glyph Corridor, repeat each round: Build new lists in one line with list comprehensions to transform chalk marks. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the lab_output value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the spirit lantern using at most 15 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The spirit lantern reached with actions_used <= 15.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 15 before the spirit lantern is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 2 (intro tier): Comprehension Lab
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Comprehension Lab' (Week 7 slot 11), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Glyph Corridor'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how lab_output changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cursed statues in Glyph Corridor.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The spirit lantern reached with actions_used <= 15.
